name: ShopRefund
description: The refund record for a receipt.

amount.description: A number equal to the refund total.

created_timestamp.description: The date & time of the refund, in epoch seconds.

reason.description: The reason string given for the refund.

note_from_issuer.description: The note string created by the refund issuer.
note_from_issuer.example: Thanks for your order! Shipping out tomorrow.

status.description: The status indication string for the refund.
